verdicts.originalText: Two effects on the Heartstopper Strike cast: +4% CRIT Rate per Declension stack (1–4) and, at 4 stacks (Conviction), an additional +32% CRIT DMG. Assert via notation: `Heizou {declension:N} E` where N is the stack count at cast (1–4). The 1s buff window is a placeholder (both effects are single-cast CRIT modifiers on the hit, not duration buffs); v1 can't scope it more tightly.
verdicts.proposedText: These CRIT bonuses only appear when you assert the stack count — add `{declension:N}` before E (N = 1–4). Shown as a 1s window, but it's a per-hit CRIT modifier on that cast, not a lasting buff.
verdicts.rationale: Rewrite: the original names both the character and the ability (both shown in the panel), carries a banned version tag ('v1'), and opens by re-explaining kit values the user already knows and that the tool renders correctly. The genuinely user-facing content is that the bonuses require asserting the Declension stack count via notation (wave-3 authored-manual-trigger case) and that the 1s window is a cosmetic placeholder for a per-hit CRIT modifier. Kept the notation-token instruction (allowed under the 'add'/'assert' verbs) and the placeholder divergence; dropped the numeric kit values and version note. Not implementDelete — manual assertion is by design (Declension auto-tracking is unauthored) and the placeholder scoping is a real limitation.

demotedNotes: Dropped from caveat during A7 compression: the two C6 buffs render correctly when the stack count is asserted (+4% CR per Declension stack, +32% CD at 4-stack Conviction) — these are working behavior, not a limitation. The former 'v1 can't scope it more tightly' note refers to the 1s placeholder duration, a known limitation since both are per-hit CRIT modifiers on the cast rather than duration buffs.
